meta.source: Kaava Design System canvas v0.2; neutrals from @makeplane/propel 0.8.3 (Plane CE v1.4.2); accent and mark from the orchestrator repo (src/tokens.css, assets/kaava-mark-colour.svg)

tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: Window root only: title bar, app switcher, status bar and the 6px gutters between regions. Used once per window.

tokens.name: bg-surface-1
tokens.usage: Every region: tool window, editor, bottom panel, right panel, settings. Regions are siblings, never nested.

tokens.name: bg-surface-2
tokens.usage: A secondary region beside a surface-1 region (rare).

tokens.name: bg-layer-1
tokens.usage: Rows, inputs and cards inside a surface-1 region.

tokens.name: bg-layer-1-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on anything drawn with bg-layer-1, and on transparent rows.

tokens.name: bg-layer-1-selected
tokens.usage: The selected tree row, terminal, settings section or segmented tab.

tokens.name: bg-layer-2
tokens.usage: The active app-switcher tab, menus, the search palette, a chip inside a card.

tokens.name: bg-layer-2-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on bg-layer-2.

tokens.name: bg-layer-3
tokens.usage: Third depth: a chip inside a menu, a code chip inside a card.

tokens.name: bg-inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltips only.

tokens.name: bg-backdrop
tokens.usage: Behind the search palette and modal dialogs.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Region edges and every divider. Borders separate; shadows do not.

tokens.name: border-subtle-1
tokens.usage: Input and search-field edges, overlay edges.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary button edge, checkbox edge, detached-window edge.

tokens.name: border-strong-1
tokens.usage: Secondary button edge on hover.

tokens.name: txt-primary
tokens.usage: Titles, active tabs, selected rows, code text.

tokens.name: txt-secondary
tokens.usage: Tree rows, menu items, body labels.

tokens.name: txt-tertiary
tokens.usage: Inactive tabs, descriptions, icon strokes. The lightest text allowed below 16px.

tokens.name: txt-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholders, section labels (STAGED), keyboard hints, paths.

tokens.name: txt-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls, ignored files, line numbers. 4.65:1 on surface-1 in dark, 4.23:1 on white in light (below AA): never for text a person must read in light theme.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Amber, the default accent (a user setting). Active tab underline, focus, drop targets, primary button fill. Never a side bar on selected rows.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Accent chips: the branch chip, count badges, step numbers.

tokens.name: txt-accent
tokens.usage: Links and text on accent-subtle.

tokens.name: txt-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Dark text in dark theme, white in light theme.

tokens.name: accent-blue
tokens.usage: Accent option: Blue.

tokens.name: accent-green
tokens.usage: Accent option: Green.

tokens.name: accent-violet
tokens.usage: Accent option: Violet.

tokens.name: accent-coral
tokens.usage: Accent option: Coral.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status dot: agent finished, tool healthy, GitHub connected, diff additions.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind success badges and the A git chip.

tokens.name: txt-success
tokens.usage: Text on success-subtle.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Status dot: needs update, modified file, agent working.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind warning badges and the M git chip.

tokens.name: txt-warning
tokens.usage: Text on warning-subtle.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Status dot: not installed, build failed, deleted file. Destructive buttons on hover.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger badges, the D git chip, destructive buttons at rest.

tokens.name: txt-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger-subtle; field error messages.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Status dot: running, untracked file, cloud agent live.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind info badges and the U git chip.

tokens.name: txt-info
tokens.usage: Text on info-subtle.

tokens.name: state-idle
tokens.usage: A status dot with nothing to report: Plane asleep, server off.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (follows the accent). Budget tones use success, warning, danger.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2. Budget tones use success, warning, danger.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3. Budget tones use success, warning, danger.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4. Budget tones use success, warning, danger.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5. Budget tones use success, warning, danger.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Chart series 6. Budget tones use success, warning, danger.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart grid and axis lines. Budget tones use success, warning, danger.

tokens.name: syn-keyword
tokens.usage: Editor: keywords.

tokens.name: syn-type
tokens.usage: Editor: types.

tokens.name: syn-function
tokens.usage: Editor: function names.

tokens.name: syn-string
tokens.usage: Editor: strings.

tokens.name: syn-number
tokens.usage: Editor: numbers and booleans.

tokens.name: syn-comment
tokens.usage: Editor: comments (grey, not green).

tokens.name: mark-skin
tokens.usage: The mark's outer body. Brand colour: never in the interface.

tokens.name: mark-flesh
tokens.usage: The mark's inner body. Brand colour: never in the interface.

tokens.name: mark-seed
tokens.usage: The mark's seed. Brand colour: never in the interface.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Settings section title, full-screen page title.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: A setting's name, a card title.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: The workhorse: tabs, tree rows, menus, buttons.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Active tab, selected row, button label.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: What Kaava offers the coding agents running in its terminals.

styles.name: code
styles.sample: pub fn resize(&mut self, bounds: Rect)

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in small controls.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Gutter between regions; icon gap in md controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row padding, gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and settings-row padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gap in settings and Home.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Git chips, keyboard hints, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tree rows, badges.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, app-switcher tabs, cards.

tokens.name: radius-region
tokens.usage: Every region on the canvas.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the search palette, settings window.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: The active app-switcher tab, a dragged tab.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, toasts, the search palette, dialogs.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Row actions, segmented panel tabs, git chips' row.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default: tree rows, buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Settings inputs, commit button, search field.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Dialog buttons.

tokens.name: control-2xl
tokens.usage: Home start actions, onboarding.

tokens.name: h-titlebar
tokens.usage: Title bar height.

tokens.name: h-switcher
tokens.usage: App switcher height.

tokens.name: h-paneltabs
tokens.usage: Tab strip inside a region.

tokens.name: h-statusbar
tokens.usage: Status bar height.

tokens.name: w-panel-default
tokens.usage: Right panel open width.

tokens.name: w-panel-collapsed
tokens.usage: Right panel collapsed to its icon rail.
